tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_customers
tools.description: List all customers (debtors) with number, name, address, contact and bank data. API: GET /customers.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by customer number. API: GET /customers/{customernumber}.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_invoices
tools.description: List customer invoices. Filter by status (OPEN, PAID, OVERDUE), date range and customer number. API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one customer invoice with its customer and line items. API: GET /invoices/{invoice_number}.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_invoice_payments
tools.description: List the payments booked against one customer invoice. API: GET /invoices/{invoice_number}/payments.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_payments_since
tools.description: List incoming invoice payments that were not marked as processed after a time stamp. This tool only reads: it never marks a payment as processed. API: GET /invoices/payment_list?processed=.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_parts
tools.description: List parts (articles) with number, description, unit, price and account numbers. API: GET /parts.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_vendors
tools.description: List vendors (creditors). Sort by id, name, vendornumber or score (add asc or desc) and search by name. API: GET /vendors.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_vendor_invoices
tools.description: List vendor invoices (payables) with status, amounts, paid amount and vendor. API: GET /payables.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_get_vendor_invoice
tools.description: Get one vendor invoice by invoice number. API: GET /payables/{invoice_number}.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_vendor_invoice_payments
tools.description: List the payments booked against one vendor invoice. API: GET /payables/{invoice_number}/payments.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_charts
tools.description: List the chart of accounts. Optionally filter by account type. API: GET /charts.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_trial_balance
tools.description: Get account balances (trial balance, version 2). Use x as a wildcard in accno (15xx = 1500 to 1599). Income statement accounts need from and to. API: GET /gl/v2/saldo.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_account_transactions
tools.description: List ledger transactions of one account or a wildcard pattern (x matches any digit, use x for all accounts). API: GET /charts/{accno}/transactions.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_departments
tools.description: List departments (cost and profit centers). API: GET /departments.
